description: This file defines a template interface for an iterator type within the WPEFramework RPC namespace. It includes method declarations for iterating over elements, resetting position, checking validity, and retrieving the current element.

classes.name: IIteratorType
classes.description: A template interface for iterator types, enabling iteration over elements of a specified type, with methods for navigation and retrieval.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element and outputs it.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous element and outputs it.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator position to the specified index.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current element at the iterator position.
